markBrief: The Arabic word نسق alone. No separate symbol and no Latin lettering in the logo or loader. Preserve teal, mint, ivory and ink.

wordmark.distribution: Outlined SVG paths only; source TTF and OFL are offline artwork inputs. No runtime font dependency.
wordmark.uiTypography: IBM Plex Sans Arabic and IBM Plex Sans unchanged

loader: Arabic wordmark itself, reconstructed handwriting: connected noon descent through seen, then qaf head, bowl and terminal return, followed by a pen lift and noon diamond. Exact existing outline retained, including qaf's incorporated end marks. Transparent teal/white GIFs; 3.6-second loop, 90 frames at 25 fps; full-word hold, clear and restart without reverse erasing; static reduced-motion fallback.
scope: Independent Nasaq identity. Upstream fonts retain their SIL Open Font License. No official endorsement, DGA certification, or trademark clearance is implied.
